title: Case #3412 - STI Screening Follow-up
content: Individual showed concerns about STI exposure. Assisted with scheduling and transportation to the clinic for screening on 02/15/2022. Results came back positive for chlamydia. Provided counseling and discussed treatment options. Referred to local support groups and community resources for further assistance.

title: Case #3413 - Mental Health Support
content: Joint case with Lisa regarding mental health support for a recent immigrant facing adjustment difficulties. Arranged for language-appropriate therapy sessions. Next appointment scheduled for 02/25/2022.
